source_scope: GWTC-5.0 public standard-siren cosmology output audit
descriptive_findings: Public H0 posterior outputs are not invariant to all frozen analysis-route choices.
Pipeline, catalog, weighting and population-model changes produce route/model-dependent descriptive shifts.
The audited IFAR validation variants show the largest highlighted descriptive shifts/distances among the frozen comparisons, but no binary materiality/significance claim is licensed.
Final spectral+bright and dark+bright released posterior products differ descriptively.
Bright-only primary comparisons C11/C12 were not executable under the frozen direct-sample contract; the official grid-density conversion is post-hoc only.
headline_reconstruction_boundary: Public final posterior sample summaries were cross-checked against the release summary table but are not claimed to be exact headline-statistic reconstruction.
causal_boundary: Observed output dependence is not causal proof of bias/error in any pipeline, catalog, population model, or event-selection rule.
H0_truth_boundary: No true-H0 estimate or Hubble-tension resolution is claimed.
